description: A DSP48E1 with SEL_PATTERN "C" writes SEL_PATTERN_C into the bitstream
exercises: the DSP48E1 SEL_PATTERN_C feature in the FASM writer
the DSP_0 SEL_PATTERN_C row of the prjxray database
why: A DSP48E1 that compares against its C input (SEL_PATTERN "C") needs the SEL_PATTERN_C bit; without it the pattern detector compares against the PATTERN attribute instead. Release 2026-10-14 writes no SEL_PATTERN_C (openXC7/nextpnr#95 adds it, prjxray-db#33 gives it a row), and the design assembles all the same with the wrong comparison. Vivado sets the bit for this very design on DSP48_X0Y20.
